newsitem.title: UK: New LIFFE Bobl futures/options -- specifications.
newsitem.headline: New LIFFE Bobl futures/options -- specifications.

text.p: Following are the specifications for new Bobl futures and options contracts which LIFFE said on Wednesday it planned to launch in September/October 1997:

* The futures contract will be a 250,000 mark nominal value notional German government bond with a six percent coupon. * Delivery months will be March, June, September and December. * The delivery day will be the 10th calendar day of the delivery month. If such a day is not a working day in Frankfurt, the delivery day will be the following Frankfurt working day. * The last trading day will be three Frankfurt working days prior to delivery day, at 11:30 Frankfurt time. * Trading hours and APT trading hours to be announced. * Minimum price movement will be 0.01 marks, quotation will be per 100 mark nominal value.
* Unit of trading will be one Bobl futures contract.
* Delivery months will be March, June, September, December plus additional serial months including the three nearest calendar months.

* Delivery will be on the first business day after the exercise day. * Exercise will be by 1700 on any business day, brought forward to a time yet to be announced on the last trading day. * Expiry on the last trading day is yet to be announced. The last trading day is to be announced six business days prior to the first day of the expiry month. * Minimum price movement will be 0.01 marks, quotation will be in multiples of 0.01 marks.
* Trading hours are to be announced. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 6784
